ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of childcare fraud in Minnesota, including the entities involved and the amounts of money lost to fraud.
questions: What is the extent of childcare fraud in Minnesota?
Which entities are involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: Childcare fraud is a significant issue in Minnesota, with potential losses in the millions. By analyzing data and public records, we can uncover the scope of the problem and identify the entities involved.
